Information.Description: Liraglutide is a lipopeptide that is an analogue of human GLP-1 in which the lysine residue at position 27 is replaced by arginine and a hexadecanoyl group attached to the remaining lysine via a glutamic acid spacer. Used as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. It has a role as a neuroprotective agent and a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist. It is a polypeptide and a lipopeptide.
